name: Knauss School of Business

employment_rate_pct.stat: secured employment within 3 months of graduation, average over three years

notes: No GMAT, GRE, acceptance rate, or international percent published on the program page. Tuition is published only per unit: 1790 per unit for master's students, 2026-27, on the graduate catalog tuition and fees page (https://graduate.catalog.sandiego.edu/academics/tuitionandfees); no official annual or total full-time MBA tuition is posted, so tuition_usd is left null rather than derived. City and state confirmed via the university's own pages; USD is a private university.
